permission.title: Allow camera
permission.body: The body check needs your camera. Your photos stay private.

camera.autoA11y: Automatic: one tap takes all photos one after another
camera.access: For your body check photos. They stay private.

turn.back: Turn your back to the camera

camera.consent: By tapping “{{done}}” you consent to your photos and body data being sent to OpenAI (USA) for the assessment.

unavailable.title: Camera didn't start
unavailable.message: Close the body check and open it again. If that doesn't help, restart the app.

offline.title: No connection
offline.message: The analysis needs the internet. Your photos are kept.

limit.title: Daily limit reached
limit.message: You've started several analyses today. You can continue tomorrow.

notAdult.title: Only from 18
notAdult.message: The body check is only available from age 18.

notPro.title: Loqqa Pro needed
notPro.message: The analysis is part of Loqqa Pro.

refused.title: Photos can't be analysed
refused.message: Please retake them in sportswear or underwear.

failed.title: Analysis didn't work
failed.message: Your photos are kept. Please try again.

result.disclaimer: Estimate from photos, not a medical assessment.
result.deleteHint: This check’s photos and values are deleted for good.
result.notFound: This body check no longer exists.

saveFailed.title: Body check not saved
saveFailed.message: Your photos and result are still here. Please try again.
